methods.name: public abstract void showInterstitial(boolean allowReporting)
methods.comment:
* Display the default interstitial. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#SAFE_BROWSING_RESPONSE_SHOW_INTERSTITIAL}. * * @param allowReporting {@code true} if the interstitial should show a reporting checkbox.

methods.name: public abstract void proceed(boolean report)
methods.comment:
* Act as if the user clicked the "visit this unsafe site" button. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#SAFE_BROWSING_RESPONSE_PROCEED}. * * @param report {@code true} to enable Safe Browsing reporting.

methods.name: public abstract void backToSafety(boolean report)
methods.comment:
* Act as if the user clicked the "back to safety" button. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#SAFE_BROWSING_RESPONSE_BACK_TO_SAFETY}. * * @param report {@code true} to enable Safe Browsing reporting.
